articles.title: BNY sees 'FOMO' driving asset managers into tokenized funds
articles.snippet: Fund issuers are exploring blockchain-based ETFs amid fears of missing an early foothold in tokenized finance.

articles.title: THORChain resumes trading more than month after $10M exploit
articles.snippet: THORChain resumed all network activity after implementing multiple security upgrades and a vault migration to fix the vulnerabilities that led to the $10.7 million exploit.

articles.title: Ethereum Layer-2 Taiko Warns Users to Withdraw Bridge Funds After Security Breach
articles.snippet: Researchers estimate more than $1.7 million was stolen after attackers allegedly exploited Taiko's proof verification process.
